title: Window Functions
description: Use ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG, LEAD, and running totals.

data.text: Window functions compute values across rows related to the current row without collapsing groups.

data.title: Running Total
data.code:
SELECT id, total, SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY created_at) AS running_total
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
LIMIT 100;

data.title: LAG and LEAD
Key Takeaways
points: Window functions do not collapse groups.
Use ORDER BY for running values.
Use PARTITION BY for grouped windows.
